output.title: I built Streakly, a habit tracker that lets you repair missed days instead of losing your streak
output.body:
I kept quitting habit apps the day I missed a check-in. That guilt spiral — broken streak, lost motivation, app deleted — felt inevitable. So I built Streakly to survive real life.

Instead of punishing missed days, Streakly lets you repair them by doubling up within the week. Your streak lives on. Habits are scored against weekly targets, not unbroken chains, based on behavior-change research that values consistency over perfection.

It’s private by default — no accounts, no social feed, all data on-device. Built for people who’ve abandoned two or three trackers already.

We’re in beta with 800 TestFlight users. 41% are still tracking at day 30 (vs. typical 10-15%), and we’ve got a 4.8-star average from 96 reviews. The most-requested feature — streak repair — is free and core, not a paywall.

I’m the founder. Would love your feedback on the approach: does this feel like a healthier way to build habits? {APP_URL}
